title: Hex Siege

Its strongest non-puzzle trait is tactical planning against an opponent, prioritizing board control, threat creation, and positional advantage, albeit in a turn-based micro scale rather than real-time.
This is a weak but plausible fit only because players benefit from remembering threat patterns, line restrictions, and surround outcomes across a compact board.
There is a faint defensive-readiness similarity in trying to avoid encirclement and maintain a stable formation, though the game lacks waves, spawning pressure, or holdout structure.
This is only a thematic approximation reflecting a head-to-head elimination duel inside a compact arena space; the actual mechanics are much closer to abstract board tactics than combat action.
